caption: Our welcome sign coming into Two-Mile-Borris from the east, with its lovely gabion stone base sitting in front of the trimmed hedgerow (May 2026)

Cheque presentation at the welcome sign on a bright spring afternoon. The gabion-stone plinth with the village name in Irish and English, and the website name on the front, has become a real focal point at this end of the village (Spring 2025)
